title: Model training method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: Ping An Technology Shenzhen Co Ltd

pse.problem: Data heterogeneity between image data of different clients leads to poor model training results in federated learning
pse.solution_function: The system performs label prediction and feature extraction on unlabeled image data using an original model (consisting of a graph convolutional network and a convolutional neural network). It then performs projection clustering to obtain domain labels and domain combination labels. A distance loss function is calculated based on these labels, which are used to update the original model parameters for global model improvement.
pse.solution_structure: The system comprises a client with an original model, consisting of a graph convolutional network and a convolutional neural network. It communicates with a server to send updated model parameters.
pse.solution_implementation: The original image data is input into the original model for label prediction and feature extraction. The extracted features are projected and clustered to obtain domain labels and domain combination labels. A distance loss function is calculated, and model parameters are updated based on this loss function and cross-entropy loss function using a preset activation function.
pse.effect: Improved training efficiency and accuracy of the model
